extraction.notes: Whole document read (81 pages). The source covers eight Cluster 3 chapters; none is an in-scope chapter, so only technology and AI material meeting the materiality test (rules 0.4) was extracted. Chapter 10 (pages 6-13) was read sentence by sentence: sections I to III (institutional set-up, electronic communications, digital transformation) extracted in full where claims were made; section IV (audio-visual media) treated as outside the theme; section V (anti-corruption) extracted only where the digital issue is the subject, with sector-framing cases flagged theme_doubtful. Other chapters were searched and read around every digital keyword: taxation (EU excise systems, taxpayer e-services), economic policy (ERP priority on digital public services), enterprise policy (business digitalisation, e-services portal, business registration, construction permit portal, beneficial owners register), science (HPC and EOSC), education (digital transformation of education, Europass) and customs (EU customs IT systems, interoperability platform). Not extracted as back-office sector systems or incidental (R22, R12): national excise control akin to EMCS, the PRO IT tax system, customs excise information systems, the anti-corruption IT tools (LUCA, integrity modules), the social assistance IT system, EMIS and education data collection, ISO certificate databases, customs national import/export, CIMS and API plans, customs IT staffing in the Commission assessment, online forms and websites, Copernicus and EU Space Programme services, digital and green references in tourism, FITD and S3, and digital skills not linked to an in-scope recommendation (teacher digital skills, ICILS). Media items (audiovisual law, video-sharing platforms, online media register) are outside the theme. Country presentation parts are recorded as North Macedonia's reported view; Commission assessment and summary parts as the Commission. Screening wording ('partially aligned') is not the annual-report scale; only 'moderately prepared' (Chapter 16) was recorded in eu_scale. period_covered is empty in the register and the report gives none (screening meetings 2019 to 2023).
